title: Looking up at the machine-gun nest, Núi Bà Đen, at dusk
description: The summit rocks in silhouette against an amber-and-blue evening sky, a utility pole and antenna wire crossing the frame, and on the highest boulder the dark shape of a gun position. Faint white lettering shows on the rock face at lower right. "Nui Ba Den looking up at the machine gun nest."
researchNotes: Identified by Larry on 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0045-c18308817.json). The painted lettering is the same boulder complex as VN-0035, whose names he has already gone through (seven negatives, 2026-09-02); nothing new is legible here. VN-0069, shot in daylight, shows the same crest with 'machine guns on top of the rock' in his words, so the two frames describe one position from two lights.
